student_claim: A student guessed a non-resonant particular solution without multiplying by the secular resonance factor x (or x^2 for a double characteristic root), or reported an RK4 decimal instead of the exact closed form.

title: Laplace analytic continuation left of convergence half-plane (C111)
problem_prompt: Let F(s) denote the meromorphic analytic continuation to C of the Laplace transform L{exp(3*t)*cos(2*t)}(s) (originally defined for Re(s) > 3). Evaluate F(1) in exact rational form.
student_claim: A student plugged s = 1 directly into the improper integral int_0^inf exp(-s*t)*f(t) dt (or numerically integrated on [0, 30]) and claimed the analytic continuation F(1) does not exist because Re(s) <= 3.

title: Laplace analytic continuation left of convergence half-plane (C113)
problem_prompt: Let F(s) denote the meromorphic analytic continuation to C of the Laplace transform L{t*exp(2*t)}(s) (originally defined for Re(s) > 2). Evaluate F(-1) in exact rational form.
student_claim: A student noted that although the improper integral int_0^inf exp(-s*t)*f(t) dt converges only for Re(s) > 2, its closed-form rational Laplace transform F(s) = 1/(s^2-4*s+4) extends by analytic continuation to C \ {2}, giving F(-1) = 1/9.

title: Order-4 complex pole exact residue (C116)
problem_prompt: Find the exact complex residue Res(f, z = 1) of f(z) = exp(2*z) / (z - 1)^4 at its pole z = 1 of order 4 in simplified exact form.
student_claim: A student forgot the 1/(m-1)! factorial factor in the order-4 pole residue formula (or used a tiny r = 1e-4 Cauchy contour quadrature where dividing by r^3 amplifies IEEE-754 rounding noise).

title: Order-3 complex pole exact residue (C117)
problem_prompt: Find the exact complex residue Res(f, z = 0) of f(z) = cos(2*z) / z^3 at its pole z = 0 of order 3 in simplified exact form.
student_claim: A student expanded cos(2*z) = 1 - 2*z^2 + (2/3)*z^4 - ... into its Laurent series around z = 0 and extracted the exact coefficient of z^(-1) in cos(2*z)/z^3, which is -2.
